facts.text: Melanie recalled a camping trip last year where they observed the Perseid meteor shower, describing the experience as amazing and feeling at one with the universe.

evidence.quote: I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe.

facts.text: Melanie described the sky during the meteor shower as clear and filled with stars, emphasizing the awe-inspiring nature of the event.

evidence.quote: The sky was so clear and filled with stars, and the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring.

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that the family camping trip includes activities such as roasting marshmallows, telling stories around the campfire, and enjoying each other's company.

evidence.quote: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company.

facts.text: Melanie expressed a sense of awe and humility during the meteor shower, reflecting on how it reminded her of the vastness and beauty of life.

evidence.quote: It was one of those moments where I felt tiny and in awe of the universe. Reminds me how awesome life is - so many little moments like that.
